name: Yexing Ji Wen
source:
When the anchor desk of the "Evening News" is reduced to a circus stage, and life cycles endlessly between compromise and numbness, a sudden live broadcast "accident" yanks the veteran journalist Lu Ming back into the eye of the storm.

If the world itself is absurd enough,
then what exactly can be considered madness?

[From [url=https://yuge0w0.itch.io/chronicles-of-the-night-walk]Itch.io[/url]]
